document_title: Mustard (Sarson/Raya) advisory from PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26

sections.symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck cell sap from tender twigs, inflorescence, leaves, and siliquae (pods). Infested plants show curling of leaves, stunted growth, and pod failure. Secretes honeydew leading to sooty mold development.
sections.recommended_action: From the first week of January, check 12-16 scattered plants per acre twice a week. Spray when there are 50-60 aphids per 10 cm of the central shoot tip, or 0.5 to 1.0 cm of the tip is covered by aphids, or 40-50% of plants are infested. Spray 40 g Actara 25 WG (thiamethoxam) or 400 ml Rogor 30 EC (dimethoate) or 400 ml Metasystox 25 EC (oxydemeton methyl) in 80-125 liters of water per acre. Repeat whenever the threshold is reached again.
sections.preventive_measures: Sow at the recommended time, preferably by the third week of October, and apply the recommended dose of fertilizers.
sections.critical_safety_warning: Spray in the late afternoon to protect honeybees visiting the flowers.
sections.source_reference: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, pages 54-55

sections.section_title: White Rust (Safed Kungi) and Blight Management in Mustard
sections.disease_pest_name: White Rust (Albugo candida) and Alternaria Blight (Alternaria brassicae)
sections.symptoms: Prominent chalky white blisters appear on the lower surface of leaves. Hypertrophy and malformation of floral parts (Staghead formation) leading to sterile flowers without seeds. Alternaria blight: brown to black spots with concentric rings on leaves, pods and stems.
sections.recommended_action: For white rust, spray 250 g Ridomil Gold (metalaxyl 4% + mancozeb 64%) dissolved in 100 liters of water per acre at 60 and 80 days after sowing. If needed, repeat the spray after 20 days.
sections.preventive_measures: Destroy diseased crop debris from the previous crop; this reduces both white rust and Alternaria blight.
sections.source_reference: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, pages 55-56

sections.recommended_action: Fertilizer for irrigated mustard (raya, gobhi sarson): 40 kg N and 12 kg P2O5 per acre, that is 90 kg urea and 75 kg single superphosphate. Give half the urea and all the superphosphate at sowing and the other half of the urea with the first irrigation. Single superphosphate also supplies sulphur; if it is not available, apply 80 kg gypsum per acre at sowing on sulphur-deficient soils. Apply 10 kg muriate of potash per acre only on potassium-deficient soils.
sections.preventive_measures: Irrigation: give the first irrigation 3 to 4 weeks after sowing. In gobhi sarson, give the second irrigation at the end of December and the last in the second fortnight of February; irrigating after that can cause lodging.
sections.source_reference: PAU Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab, Rabi 2025-26, pages 50-53
